name: capability
description: The task-independent capability study: what each interface sees, standing and flying, across clutter. C0-C2 are the study's own clutter levels (packed blocks: 4 m facade gaps close the blocks to the avoidance law at C1/C2); C1p/C2p are porous cities at C1/C2's block spacing and street width (citygen core=shell: every two avoidance cylinders at least w_pass(1.0) = 6 m apart, the gate probe's narrowest gap the formation flows through), at the densest coverage that core reaches without jamming. One goal level (today's patch), so C0-C2 are the tierB2 sweep's G0 layouts.
